items.source: The default concrete implementation chosen at runtime will be either DelegatingSmartContextLoader or WebDelegatingSmartContextLoader depending on the absence or presence of @WebAppConfiguration. For further details on the default behavior of various concrete SmartContextLoaders, check out the Javadoc for AbstractContextLoader, GenericXmlContextLoader, GenericGroovyXmlContextLoader, AnnotationConfigContextLoader, GenericXmlWebContextLoader, GenericGroovyXmlWebContextLoader, and AnnotationConfigWebContextLoader.
items.translation: 运行时选择的默认具体实现将是 DelegatingSmartContextLoader 或 WebDelegatingSmartContextLoader，具体取决于 @WebAppConfiguration 的缺失或存在。有关各种具体 SmartContextLoaders 默认行为的更多详细信息，请查看 AbstractContextLoader、GenericXmlContextLoader、GenericGroovyXmlContextLoader、AnnotationConfigContextLoader、GenericXmlWebContextLoader、GenericGroovyXmlWebContextLoader 和 AnnotationConfigWebContextLoader 的 Javadoc。

items.source: Context loaders may choose to support either path-based resource locations (typically XML configuration files) or class-based resources. Alternatively, context loaders may choose to support path-based and class-based resources simultaneously. Consequently @ContextConfiguration can be used to declare either path-based resource locations (via the locations() or value() attribute) or component classes (via the classes() attribute). Note, however, that most implementations of SmartContextLoader only support a single resource type. Path-based resource locations may be either XML configuration files or Groovy scripts (if Groovy is on the classpath). Of course, third-party frameworks may choose to support additional types of path-based resources.
items.translation: 上下文加载器 可以选择支持基于路径的资源位置（通常是 XML 配置文件）或 基于类的资源。或者，上下文加载器也可以选择同时支持基于路径 和 基于类的资源。因此，可以使用 @ContextConfiguration 来声明基于路径的资源位置（通过 locations() 或 value() 属性）或 组件类（通过 classes() 属性）。然而，请注意，大多数 SmartContextLoader 的实现仅支持单一类型的资源。基于路径的资源位置可以是 XML 配置文件或 Groovy 脚本（如果类路径中包含 Groovy）。当然，第三方框架可以选择支持其他类型的基于路径的资源。

items.source: In the following example, the ApplicationContext for ExtendedTest will be initialized using BaseInitializer and ExtendedInitializer. Note, however, that the order in which the initializers are invoked depends on whether they implement Ordered or are annotated with @Order.
items.translation: 在以下示例中，ExtendedTest 的ApplicationContext将使用BaseInitializer和ExtendedInitializer进行初始化。然而请注意，初始化的调用顺序取决于它们是否实现了Ordered接口或是否标注了@Order注解。

items.source: Note that the aforementioned default rules only apply for a standard AbstractContextLoader subclass such as GenericXmlContextLoader or GenericGroovyXmlContextLoader which are the effective default implementations used at runtime if locations are configured. See the documentation for loader() for further details regarding default loaders.
items.translation: 请注意，上述默认规则仅适用于标准 `AbstractContextLoader` 子类，例如 `GenericXmlContextLoader` 或 `GenericGroovyXmlContextLoader`，这些是运行时在配置了 `locations 时实际使用的默认实现。有关默认加载器的更多详细信息，请参阅 loader() 的文档。

items.source: In the following example that uses path-based resource locations, the ApplicationContext for ExtendedTest will be loaded from "base-context.xml" and "extended-context.xml", in that order. Beans defined in "extended-context.xml" may therefore override those defined in "base-context.xml".
items.translation: 在以下使用基于路径的资源位置的示例中，`ExtendedTest` 的ApplicationContext将按顺序从"base-context.xml"和"extended-context.xml"加载。因此，在"extended-context.xml"中定义的 Bean 可能会覆盖在"base-context.xml"中定义的 Bean。

items.source: Similarly, in the following example that uses component classes, the ApplicationContext for ExtendedTest will be loaded from the BaseConfig and ExtendedConfig configuration classes, in that order. Beans defined in ExtendedConfig may therefore override those defined in BaseConfig.
items.translation: 同样，在以下使用组件类的示例中，`ExtendedTest` 的 ApplicationContext 将按顺序从 BaseConfig 和 ExtendedConfig 配置类中加载。因此，ExtendedConfig 中定义的 Bean 可能会覆盖 BaseConfig 中定义的 Bean。

items.source: This attribute is only applicable when used within a test class hierarchy or enclosing class hierarchy that is configured using @ContextHierarchy, in which case the name can be used for merging or overriding this configuration with configuration of the same name in hierarchy levels defined in superclasses or enclosing classes. As of Spring Framework 6.2.6, the name can also be used to identify the configuration in which a Bean Override should be applied — for example, @MockitoBean(contextName = "child"). See the Javadoc for @ContextHierarchy for details.
items.translation: 此属性仅在测试类层次结构或配置了 `@ContextHierarchy` 的包围类层次结构中适用，在这种情况下，该名称可用于与在父类或包围类中定义的层次级别中具有相同名称的配置进行合并或覆盖。自 Spring Framework 6.2.6 起，该名称还可用于标识应应用Bean Override的配置——例如 `@MockitoBean(contextName = "child")`。有关详细信息，请参阅 Javadoc 中的@ContextHierarchy。

items.source: Consult the Javadoc for @Configuration and @Bean for further information regarding the configuration and semantics of component classes.
items.translation: 有关组件类的配置和语义的更多信息，请查阅@Configuration和@Bean的 Javadoc。

items.source: This attribute may not be used in conjunction with locations(), but it may be used instead of locations().
items.translation: 此属性不能与locations()一起使用，但可以作为locations()的替代方案。

items.source: This attribute may not be used in conjunction with value(), but it may be used instead of value().
items.translation: 此属性不能与value()一起使用，但可以作为value()的替代方案。

items.source: Check out the javadoc for AnnotationConfigContextLoader.detectDefaultConfigurationClasses() for details on how default configuration classes will be detected if no component classes are specified. See the documentation for loader() for further details regarding default loaders.
items.translation: 查看 AnnotationConfigContextLoader.detectDefaultConfigurationClasses() 的 javadoc，以了解在未指定任何组件类时如何检测默认配置类的详细信息。有关默认加载器的进一步详细信息，请参阅 loader() 的文档。

items.source: SmartContextLoader implementations typically detect whether Spring's Ordered interface has been implemented or if the @Order annotation is present and sort instances accordingly prior to invoking them.
items.translation: `SmartContextLoader` 实现通常检测 Spring 的 Ordered 接口是否已实现，或者是否存在 @Order 注解，并在调用这些实例之前按相应顺序对它们进行排序。

items.source: Check out the Javadoc for AbstractContextLoader.modifyLocations() for details on how a location will be interpreted at runtime, in particular in case of a relative path. Also, check out the documentation on AbstractContextLoader.generateDefaultLocations() for details on the default locations that are going to be used if none are specified.
items.translation: 查看 Javadoc 中关于 AbstractContextLoader.modifyLocations() 的详细信息，以了解位置在运行时（特别是相对路径情况下）的解释方式。此外，请查看有关 AbstractContextLoader.generateDefaultLocations() 的文档，以了解如果未指定任何内容时将使用的默认位置。

items.source: The concrete ConfigurableApplicationContext type supported by each declared initializer must be compatible with the type of ApplicationContext created by the SmartContextLoader in use.
items.translation: 每个声明的初始化程序所支持的具体的 `ConfigurableApplicationContext` 类型必须与正在使用的由 `SmartContextLoader` 创建的 `ApplicationContext` 类型兼容。

items.source: The default value is true. This means that an annotated test class will inherit the resource locations or component classes defined by test superclasses and enclosing classes. Specifically, the resource locations or component classes for a given test class will be appended to the list of resource locations or component classes defined by test superclasses and enclosing classes. Thus, subclasses and nested classes have the option of extending the list of resource locations or component classes.
items.translation: 默认值为 `true`。这意味着已注解的测试类将 继承 由测试超类和外部类定义的资源位置或组件类。具体而言，给定测试类的资源位置或组件类将被追加到由测试超类和外部类定义的资源位置或组件类列表中。因此，子类及内部类有选项来 扩展 资源位置或组件类列表。

items.source: If inheritLocations is set to false, the resource locations or component classes for the annotated test class will shadow and effectively replace any resource locations or component classes defined by superclasses and enclosing classes.
items.translation: 如果将 `inheritLocations` 设置为 `false，则被注解的测试类的资源位置或组件类将 遮蔽 并实际上替换由超类和包含类定义的任何资源位置或组件类。

items.source: The default value is true. This means that an annotated test class will inherit the application context initializers defined by test superclasses and enclosing classes. Specifically, the initializers for a given test class will be added to the set of initializers defined by test superclasses and enclosing classes. Thus, subclasses and nested classes have the option of extending the set of initializers.
items.translation: 默认值为 `true`。这意味着一个带注解的测试类将 继承 由测试超类和包含类定义的应用程序上下文初始化器。具体而言，给定测试类的初始化器将被添加到由测试超类和包含类定义的初始化器集合中。因此，子类及内部类有选项来 扩展 初始化器集合。

items.source: If inheritInitializers is set to false, the initializers for the annotated test class will shadow and effectively replace any initializers defined by superclasses and enclosing classes.
items.translation: 如果将 `inheritInitializers` 设置为 `false，则已标注测试类的初始化器将覆盖并实质上替换由超类和外部类定义的任意初始化器。

items.source: The term component class can refer to any of the following.
items.translation: 组件类 一词可指代以下任何一项。

items.source: If not specified, the loader will be inherited from the first superclass or enclosing class that is annotated or meta-annotated with @ContextConfiguration and specifies an explicit loader. If no class in the type hierarchy or enclosing class hierarchy specifies an explicit loader, a default loader will be used instead.
items.translation: 如果未指定，加载器将从第一个使用`@ContextConfiguration`注解或元注解并指定了显式加载器的父类或包围类中继承。如果在类型层次结构或包围类层次结构中没有任何类指定显式加载器，则将使用默认加载器。

items.source:
If not specified the name will be inferred based on the numerical level
within all declared contexts within the hierarchy.
items.translation: 如果未指定名称，则将在层次结构中所有声明的上下文中根据数值级别推断该名称。

items.source: The type of SmartContextLoader (or ContextLoader) to use for loading an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 用于加载 `ApplicationContext` 的 `SmartContextLoader`（或 `ContextLoader`）类型。

items.source: Whether resource locations or component classes from test superclasses and enclosing classes should be inherited.
items.translation: 无论是 `资源位置`，还是来自测试超类和包含类的`组件类` 是否应该被 `继承`。

items.source: The component classes to use for loading an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 用于加载 `ApplicationContext` 的 组件类。

items.source: The application context initializer classes to use for initializing a ConfigurableApplicationContext.
items.translation: 用于初始化ConfigurableApplicationContext的应用程序上下文初始化类。

items.source: Whether context initializers from test superclasses and enclosing classes should be inherited.
items.translation: 测试超类和外围类的上下文初始化器是否应该被继承。

items.source: The resource locations to use for loading an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 用于加载 ApplicationContext 的资源位置。

items.source: A component (i.e., a class annotated with @Component, @Service, @Repository, etc.)
items.translation: 一个组件（即带有以下注解的类： @Component、 @Service、 @Repository 等）

items.source: A class annotated with @Configuration
items.translation: 带有@Configuration注解的类

items.source: Any class that contains @Bean-methods
items.translation: 包含 `@Bean` 方法的任何类

items.source: A JSR-330 compliant class that is annotated with jakarta.inject annotations
items.translation: 一个带有 `jakarta.inject` 注解的符合 JSR-330 规范的类。

items.source: Any other class that is intended to be registered as a Spring component (i.e., a Spring bean in the ApplicationContext), potentially taking advantage of automatic autowiring of a single constructor without the use of Spring annotations
items.translation: 任何其他类，如果打算注册为 Spring 组件（即 `ApplicationContext` 中的 Spring Bean），并且可能利用单个构造函数的自动注入功能而无需使用 Spring 注解。

items.source: Supported Resource Types
items.translation: 支持的资源类型

items.source: Component Classes
items.translation: 组件类

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations.
items.translation: 此注解可用作 元注解 来创建自定义的 组合注解。

items.source: This annotation will be inherited from an enclosing test class by default. See @NestedTestConfiguration for details.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此注解将从外部测试类继承。有关详细信息，请参阅@NestedTestConfiguration。

items.source: Alias for locations().
items.translation: `locations()` 的别名。

items.source: The name of the context hierarchy level represented by this configuration.
items.translation: 该配置所表示的上下文层次结构级别的名称。
